title: A hands-on theatre tour
titleZh: 可觸摸道具的劇場導覽

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: On Sunday’s theatre tour, visitors can touch sample props. I’ve set out a wooden wheel and a foam brick. Can we add the crown?
turns.zh: 星期日的劇場導覽可讓訪客摸樣本道具。我擺了木輪和泡棉磚。可以加王冠嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The actors need it on stage. The workshop copy feels the same, but it has no jewels yet.
turns.zh: 演員在舞台上要用它。工作間的複製品摸起來一樣，只是還沒裝上寶石。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Bring the copy. Leave off the cloth. It slides when pulled.
turns.zh: 拿複製品來。別鋪桌布，一拉就會滑。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Right. I’ll set the props directly on the table, spaced apart so people can feel one at a time.
turns.zh: 好。我會把道具直接放在桌面，彼此留些距離，讓大家一次摸一件。
